risk_surfaces.reason: Public create must not synthesize occurredOn.
Invalid semantic date combinations must fail.
Transfer reconciliation must use canonical promotion.
Group edits must keep temporal fields independent.
Void/reactivation must not fabricate cash dates.
Realized reports must remain on occurredOn.
Reactivation must use the new cash-effect date.
Voiding realized history must preserve effectiveOn.
Statement and reports need distinct precedence.
Manual web producer must source occurredOn explicitly.
Recurring editor must preserve occurredOn explicitly.
Docs must keep temporal definitions consistent.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: A producer collapses independent temporal facts while happy paths still look correct.
